comportamentos: Allow an enrollment hold to remain valid when the dismissal is by withdrawal (non-approved reason) and the dismissal date falls within the hold period: present (only when the hold starts on or before the dismissal date)

Keep the after_dismissal_date error when the dismissal reason is approved (thesis_judgement == APPROVED) and the hold ends after the dismissal date: missing (the candidate drops this check whenever the hold starts before the dismissal)
Never raise after_dismissal_date for non-approved dismissals: missing (the candidate still raises it when the hold starts after the dismissal date)
justificativa: The candidate changes the check from end_date to start_date instead of scoping it to approved dismissals, so it lets the reported withdrawal case through but behaves differently from the official fix: it allows approved-dismissal overlaps and still blocks some withdrawal cases.
